competitorNotes: Git-stash humor is nearly absent: the only hit was a 'stash and relax' shirt; 'stash' searches drift to stash jars.
Git posters on Etsy are cheat sheets plus a few commit-message jokes, so a stash joke has little direct competition.
Amazon git humor is limited to the 'in case of fire' print.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: Primary 'git poster' (Etsy listing titles use it); 'git stash' leads the title for specificity. Avoided 'stash' alone in tags because Etsy reads it as stash jars. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
